title: Amid Boycott Call, Ladakh To Hold Hill Council Elections On December 4

ai.summary: Ladakh residents plan to hold hill council elections on December 4 amid calls for boycott, following the loss of statehood in 2019.

facts.claim: Ladakh residents plan to hold hill council elections on December 4
facts.quote: Amid Boycott Call, Ladakh To Hold Hill Council Elections On December 4

ai.background_note: Ladakh lost statehood in 2019 when it was split into two union territories, and the movement seeks restoration of statehood.
